reviewer: Independent hm_imprint_independent compared actual child and parent pixels; root translated the typed report.

evidence.description: Independent critic inspected this native child and step-4 parent at large size; target-size/application remain unknown.

assessments.observation: Full curves feel approachable while the heavy connected mass feels assured; no strong genre conflict with the independent studio is visible.

The asymmetric outer arch and diagonally cut internal opening create a specific visible relationship, although the first association remains an arch or lowercase-n family. This is a limited visual judgment, not a uniqueness study.
The inner upper-right corner flows more naturally; the continuous outer arch and open lower counter remain clear.
The raised counter reduces pressure from the top and the upper-right join is softer. The right interior is more vertical, slightly reducing the previous tension without clear regression.
Only the large native PNG was inspected; actual 32–64px behavior remains unverified.
Inverse, other backgrounds and actual Inter/header/credit placement were not inspected.
Only the symbol was revised. No lettering or wordmark was added; fixed typography remains outside the image task.

reason: Both optical edits visibly improved and the main character is preserved. Further generation is not justified before actual target-size and application inspection; retain a promising unverified candidate rather than mark it production-ready.
preserve: The asymmetric outer arch, its current outer silhouette and baseline
Diagonal internal top edge, open bottom, confident ink weight, flat ink on white, no lettering
unresolved: Actual 32–64px use-size rendering has not been visually inspected.
Inverse/header/credits and existing Inter context have not been visually inspected.
